name: War-Awoken Bio Burst (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Bio/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Bio Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold if there are 0-1/2+ allies with Attach Bio
WS Blue: [Lv.2 En-Bio Stack] to user
WS Gold: [During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 3 & Damage +50% to Bio Abilities] to user
